KAREN_HAIRPIN_RELIC.title: Hairpin
KAREN_HAIRPIN_RELIC.description: At the start of your [blue]2nd[/blue] turn, add a [gold]Tower of Promise[/gold] to your hand.
KAREN_HAIRPIN2_RELIC.title: Hairpin - 3D Version
KAREN_HAIRPIN2_RELIC.description: At the start of your [blue]1st[/blue] turn, add a [gold]Tower of Promise+[/gold] to your hand.
KAREN_HAIRPIN2_RELIC.flavor: Let's go to that shining stage. Together.
KAREN_LOCK_RELIC.title: Locked Relic
KAREN_LOCK_RELIC.description: A relic is locked here. It will unlock at the end of combat.
KAREN_WATER_BOTTLE_RELIC.title: Karen’s Water Bottle
KAREN_WATER_BOTTLE_RELIC.description: The first time you gain [gold]Temporary Strength[/gold] each combat, [gold]Retain Strength[/gold] for [blue]{Turns}[/blue] turns.
KAREN_COOKIE_RELIC.title: Cookies
KAREN_COOKIE_RELIC.description: Upon pickup, obtain [blue]1[/blue] random Common, Uncommon, and Rare [gold]Shine[/gold] card each.
KAREN_STAR_HAIRCLIP_RELIC.title: Star Hairclip
KAREN_STAR_HAIRCLIP_RELIC.description: At the start of combat, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Radiance[/gold] to your [gold]Promise Pile[/gold].
KAREN_BASEBALL_CAT_RELIC.title: Baseball Cat
KAREN_BASEBALL_CAT_RELIC.description: Each combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Shine Card Reward[/gold] for each distinct name of [gold]Shine[/gold] card you deplete.
KAREN_BASEBALL_CAT_RELIC.flavor: I love you even more when you shine.
KAREN_MR_WHITE_RELIC.title: Mr. White
KAREN_MR_WHITE_RELIC.description: At the end of each of your first [blue]2[/blue] turns each combat, you may put any number of cards from your hand into your [gold]Promise Pile[/gold].
KAREN_LITTLE_STAR_RELIC.title: Little Star
KAREN_LITTLE_STAR_RELIC.description: Whenever you play [gold]Tower of Promise[/gold], gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Temporary Strength[/gold].
KAREN_LITTLE_STAR_RELIC.flavor: You will find a little happiness.
KAREN_STAR_TIARA_RELIC.title: Star Crown
KAREN_STAR_TIARA_RELIC.description: At the start of each turn, [gold]disable[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] relic and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
KAREN_FLOWER_RELIC.title: Flower
KAREN_FLOWER_RELIC.description: Relic rewards have an additional option.
KAREN_FLOWER_RELIC.flavor: You'll be the first to see me shine the brightest in the world.
